newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank sells 100 bln rbls bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank sells 100 bln rbls bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 100.00 billion roubles nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Monday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 24011 issue closed on Monday at 101.20 percent, and the 24012 issue closed at 100.07 percent. The Central Bank said it raised 103.55 billion roubles from the sales.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
